name: civic-voice-engine
description: Universal government data ingestion and AI processing engine for Civic Voice

scripts.pipeline:leaders: npm run ingest:leaders && npm run process:leaders && npm run upload:leaders
scripts.upload:leaderboard: node -e "require('dotenv').config(); const {uploadLeaderboard}=require('./src/firebase/uploader'); uploadLeaderboard().then(n=>{ console.log('[upload:leaderboard] Done —',n,'docs'); process.exit(0); }).catch(e=>{ console.error(e.message); process.exit(1); })"
scripts.upload:social-stats: node -e "require('dotenv').config(); const {uploadSocialStats}=require('./src/firebase/uploader'); uploadSocialStats().then(n=>{ console.log('[upload:social-stats] Done —',n,'docs'); process.exit(0); }).catch(e=>{ console.error(e.message); process.exit(1); })"
scripts.pipeline:social-stats: npm run ingest:social-stats && npm run upload:social-stats
scripts.pipeline:live-stats: npm run live:fetch && npm run upload:social-stats
scripts.pipeline:targeted: npm run fetch:targeted && npm run upload:targeted
scripts.pipeline:member-disclosures: npm run ingest:member-disclosures && npm run upload:member-disclosures && npm run upload:member-lobbying
scripts.pipeline:member-votes: npm run ingest:member-votes && npm run upload:member-votes
scripts.pipeline:member-attendance: npm run ingest:member-attendance && npm run upload:member-attendance
scripts.pipeline:member-bios: npm run ingest:member-bios && npm run upload:member-bios
scripts.pipeline:member-committees: npm run ingest:member-committees && npm run upload:member-committees
scripts.pipeline:member-expenses: npm run ingest:member-expenses && npm run upload:member-expenses
scripts.pipeline:corporate-affiliations: npm run ingest:corporate-affiliations && npm run upload:corporate-affiliations
scripts.pipeline:promise-tracker: npm run ingest:promise-tracker && npm run upload:promise-tracker
scripts.pipeline:department-budgets: npm run ingest:department-budgets && npm run upload:department-budgets
scripts.pipeline:stock-trades: npm run ingest:stock-trades && npm run upload:stock-trades
scripts.pipeline:full: npm run start && npm run process:bills && npm run score:efficiency && npm run upload:firebase
